author: Claude taslak (H-071); kullanıcı onayı bekliyor
notes: Anlatım İngilizcede geçmiş zamanda (past simple); Türkçede de -di'li geçmiş zaman kullanıldı, konuşmalar doğal günlük Türkçeyle çevrildi.
"Aunt Füsun" Türkçede "Füsun Teyze", "Mr Selim" "Selim Bey" olarak verildi.
Kelime anlamları cümledeki kullanıma göre verildi; düzensiz geçmiş zaman fiillerinde yalın hâli parantezde (took = aldı (take → took)).

lines.en: The Empty Box
The day before the contest, the famous recipe disappeared.
lines.tr: Yarışmadan bir gün önce, ünlü tarif kayboldu.

lines.en: Well, two days before.
But it felt like one.
Elif was fifteen.
Every summer, she worked in her family's small restaurant.
lines.tr: Her yaz ailesinin küçük lokantasında çalışırdı.

lines.en: It was in Ayvalık, on a street near the sea.
lines.tr: Lokanta Ayvalık'ta, denize yakın bir sokaktaydı.

lines.en: In the mornings, Elif cut bread and carried plates.
lines.tr: Sabahları Elif ekmek keser, tabak taşırdı.

lines.en: In the evenings, she did the dishes.
The most famous thing in the restaurant was a cake.
lines.tr: Lokantadaki en ünlü şey bir kekti.

lines.en: It was Aunt Füsun's lemon cake.
People came from other towns for it.
lines.tr: İnsanlar onun için başka kasabalardan gelirdi.

lines.en: They always ate one piece and asked for a second.
lines.tr: Hep bir dilim yer, ikinciyi isterlerdi.

lines.en: Nobody knew the recipe.
Nobody except one old card.
And now the card was missing.
Who took it?
And why?
On Sunday, there was a summer cake contest in the town square.
lines.tr: Pazar günü kasaba meydanında bir yaz kek yarışması vardı.

lines.en: Every restaurant brought its best cake.
lines.tr: Her lokanta en iyi kekini getirirdi.

lines.en: This year, Elif wanted to enter with the lemon cake.
lines.tr: Bu yıl Elif yarışmaya limonlu kekle katılmak istiyordu.

lines.en: "I'm too old for contests," said Aunt Füsun.
lines.tr: "Ben yarışmalar için fazla yaşlıyım," dedi Füsun Teyze.

lines.en: She laughed.
"You go, Elif.
You can make it."
Aunt Füsun never wrote anything down.
She cooked with her hands, not with paper.
But there was one card in an old wooden box.
lines.tr: Ama eski, tahta bir kutuda tek bir kart vardı.

lines.en: It was the recipe for the lemon cake.
Everyone in the kitchen knew about that card.
On Friday morning, Elif opened the box.
She wanted to read the card again.
The box was empty.
Elif looked under the box.
She looked behind the oven and in every drawer.
lines.tr: Fırının arkasına ve bütün çekmecelere baktı.

lines.en: Nothing.
Then she looked at the kitchen table.
There was white flour on it.
And in the flour, there were marks from a hand.
lines.tr: Ve unda bir elin izleri vardı.

lines.en: Somebody touched the box with white hands.
"Everyone here has white hands," Elif thought.
lines.tr: "Burada herkesin elleri beyaz," diye düşündü Elif.

lines.en: She went to her room and found an old notebook.
lines.tr: Odasına gitti ve eski bir defter buldu.

lines.en: On the first page, she wrote three words: "Find the recipe."
lines.tr: İlk sayfaya üç kelime yazdı: "Tarifi bul."

lines.en: Under them, she wrote: "Clue one: flour on the table."
lines.tr: Altına şunu yazdı: "Birinci ipucu: masada un."

lines.en: A real detective needed clues.
lines.tr: Gerçek bir dedektifin ipuçlarına ihtiyacı vardı.

lines.en: And a real detective needed suspects.
lines.tr: Ve gerçek bir dedektifin şüphelilere ihtiyacı vardı.

lines.en: That evening, Elif gave Limon his dinner.
lines.tr: O akşam Elif, Limon'a akşam yemeğini verdi.

lines.en: Limon was the restaurant's cat.
He was fat and yellow, like a lemon.
lines.tr: Şişman ve sarıydı, tıpkı bir limon gibi.

lines.en: In the day, he slept in a basket behind the kitchen door.
lines.tr: Gündüzleri mutfak kapısının arkasındaki bir sepette uyurdu.

lines.en: At night, he always slept on Aunt Füsun's bed.
lines.tr: Geceleri ise hep Füsun Teyze'nin yatağında uyurdu.

lines.en: Elif looked into his basket.
There was something white under the cat.
lines.tr: Kedinin altında beyaz bir şey vardı.

lines.en: "Move, Limon," she said.
Limon didn't move.
Cats never move when you ask.
Elif picked him up slowly.
Under him, there was a piece of card.
It was half of a card, with old, careful writing.
lines.tr: Kartın yarısıydı, eski ve özenli bir yazıyla.

lines.en: She read the first line.
It said: "Lemon Cake."
Three Suspects
Elif read the half card again and again.
lines.tr: Elif yarım kartı tekrar tekrar okudu.

lines.en: It said "four eggs," "one glass of sugar" and "two lemons."
lines.tr: Kartta "dört yumurta", "bir bardak şeker" ve "iki limon" yazıyordu.

lines.en: The other half was missing.
Somebody broke the card in two.
Did they keep the other half?
She opened her notebook.
"Clue two: half a card in Limon's basket."
Then she wrote three names under the clues.
lines.tr: Sonra ipuçlarının altına üç isim yazdı.

lines.en: Bora.
Theo.
Mr Selim.
She liked all three people.
That was the worst part.
lines.tr: İşin en kötü yanı da buydu.

lines.en: Bora was Elif's cousin.
He was seventeen, and he loved his phone.
lines.tr: On yedi yaşındaydı ve telefonuna bayılırdı.

lines.en: He took photos of every plate in the restaurant.

words.took: çekti (take → took; take a photo: fotoğraf çekmek)

lines.en: Then he put them online.
"Did you take the recipe card?"
Elif asked him.
"Why?
I don't need a card," said Bora.
lines.tr: Benim karta ihtiyacım yok," dedi Bora.

lines.en: "I only need photos."
He showed her a photo of the lemon cake.
lines.tr: Elif'e limonlu kekin bir fotoğrafını gösterdi.

lines.en: It had fifty thousand likes.
But Elif noticed something.
lines.tr: Ama Elif bir şey fark etti.

lines.en: Bora's hands were white with flour.
"I helped with the bread this morning," he said quickly.
lines.tr: "Bu sabah ekmeğe yardım ettim," dedi hızlıca.

lines.en: Too quickly?
Elif wrote it down.
Theo was the new waiter.
He came from England, and he was learning Turkish.
He was polite and quiet.
He always carried a small blue notebook.
lines.tr: Hep küçük, mavi bir defter taşırdı.

lines.en: All day, he wrote new words in it.
lines.tr: Bütün gün ona yeni kelimeler yazardı.

lines.en: "Theo, were you in the kitchen yesterday?"
Elif asked.
"Yes.
Every morning," said Theo.
His Turkish was slow but careful.
"I come very early."
"Why so early?
The restaurant opens at ten."
Theo smiled, but he didn't answer.
He closed his notebook a little faster.
Mr Selim had the cake shop across the street.
lines.tr: Selim Bey'in sokağın karşısında pasta dükkânı vardı.

lines.en: He was the kindest man in Ayvalık.
He gave sweets to every child.
"Your aunt's recipe?
I'd love to see it!" he laughed.
"But I make my own cakes.
And mine are sweeter."
Elif compared her suspects in her notebook.
Bora was the busiest.
Theo was the quietest.
Mr Selim was the kindest.
Nobody looked like a thief.
Later that evening, Theo left his notebook on a table.
lines.tr: O akşam daha sonra Theo defterini bir masada unuttu.

lines.en: It was open.
Elif didn't want to read it.
But she saw one page.
There was a drawing of a lemon.
Next to it, there was a time: six in the morning.
lines.tr: Yanında bir saat yazıyordu: sabah altı.

lines.en: Three Bad Cakes
Elif had no card.
But she had half a card and a good memory.
lines.tr: Ama yarım kartı ve iyi bir hafızası vardı.

lines.en: She watched Aunt Füsun make the cake many times.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze'yi keki yaparken çok kez izlemişti.

lines.en: "I can do this," she said.
Then she laughed.
"No.
I can make this."
On Saturday morning, she made her first cake.
She used two lemons, like the card said.
lines.tr: Kartta yazdığı gibi iki limon kullandı.

lines.en: After forty minutes, she took it out of the oven.
lines.tr: Kırk dakika sonra onu fırından çıkardı.

lines.en: It looked perfect.
She ate a piece.
It was very sour!
Her face looked like Limon's face in the rain.
"It's more sour than a lemon," said Bora.
He took a photo.
For the second cake, Elif used one lemon and less butter.
lines.tr: İkinci kek için Elif bir limon ve daha az tereyağı kullandı.

lines.en: It wasn't sour this time.
But it was dry.
It was drier than an old shoe.
For the third cake, she added more sugar.
lines.tr: Üçüncü kek için daha fazla şeker ekledi.

lines.en: It was sweet.
It was much too sweet.
It was sweeter than Mr Selim's cakes.
Three cakes, and three bad cakes.
Elif sat down on the kitchen floor.
The contest was tomorrow.
Aunt Füsun came into the kitchen.
She tried a little piece of each cake.
lines.tr: Her kekten küçük bir parça tattı.

lines.en: Then she started to make lunch.
Elif watched her.
Aunt Füsun put oil in a pan, then onions, then tomatoes.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze tavaya yağ koydu, sonra soğan, sonra domates.

lines.en: She added a little of this and a little of that.

chunks.en: a little of this and a little of that

lines.en: She never looked at a card, a book or a phone.
lines.tr: Ne karta, ne kitaba, ne telefona baktı.

lines.en: Then Elif understood something.
She opened her notebook.
"Clue three: Aunt Füsun never cooks from paper."
lines.tr: "Üçüncü ipucu: Füsun Teyze hiçbir zaman kâğıttan yemek yapmaz."

lines.en: So why was there a card in the box?
lines.tr: Peki kutuda neden bir kart vardı?

lines.en: In the early evening, Elif heard voices behind the restaurant.
lines.tr: Akşamüstü Elif lokantanın arkasından sesler duydu.

lines.en: Theo and Aunt Füsun sat at a small table outside.
lines.tr: Theo ile Füsun Teyze dışarıda küçük bir masada oturuyordu.

lines.en: "Good evening, Theo," said Aunt Füsun slowly.
lines.tr: "İyi akşamlar, Theo," dedi Füsun Teyze yavaşça.

lines.en: She said it in English!
Theo answered her in Turkish.
Then they both laughed.
So that was Theo's secret!
Every morning at six, they had a lesson.
lines.tr: Her sabah saat altıda ders yapıyorlardı.

lines.en: Aunt Füsun taught Theo Turkish.
Theo taught Aunt Füsun English.
lines.tr: Theo da Füsun Teyze'ye İngilizce öğretti.

lines.en: The lemon was for her lessons.
She paid him with cake.
Elif put a line through Theo's name.

words.through: içinden (put a line through: üstünü çizmek)
words.name: isim, ad

lines.en: That night, Elif couldn't sleep.
At midnight, she went down for some water.
lines.tr: Gece yarısı biraz su içmek için aşağı indi.

lines.en: There was a light in the kitchen.
Aunt Füsun stood by the oven.
She didn't look surprised.
"Are you ready?" she asked.
In English.
The Real Recipe
"Ready for what?" asked Elif.
"For the real recipe," said Aunt Füsun.
She took something out of her pocket.
It was the other half of the card.
Elif's mouth opened.
"You took it?"
"I hid it," said Aunt Füsun.
"On Thursday night.
Limon helped me."
Elif remembered the flour on the table.
Aunt Füsun's hands always had flour on them.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze'nin ellerinde hep un olurdu.

lines.en: And Limon slept in Aunt Füsun's room every night.
lines.tr: Ve Limon her gece Füsun Teyze'nin odasında uyurdu.

lines.en: "He loves paper," said Aunt Füsun.
"He took one half to his basket.
I'm sorry about that."
"But why?" asked Elif.
Aunt Füsun put the two pieces together on the table.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze iki parçayı masanın üstünde birleştirdi.

lines.en: "Read it," she said.
Elif read it.
Then she read it again.
Three lemons.
Two glasses of salt.
No butter at all.
"This is wrong!" she said.
"This makes a terrible cake!"
"Of course it does," said Aunt Füsun.
"Every year, somebody wants my recipe.
Every year, somebody opens that box.
lines.tr: Her yıl biri o kutuyu açar.

lines.en: So I wrote a wrong card.
lines.tr: Ben de yanlış bir kart yazdım.

lines.en: It's a trap for people with long noses."
lines.tr: Bu, burnunu her şeye sokanlar için bir tuzak."

lines.en: "So where is the real recipe?"
Aunt Füsun showed her two hands.
Then she touched her head.
"Here.
I didn't want you to learn from paper.
I wanted you to learn with your eyes.
Today you watched me.
You saw everything."
They baked all night.
Aunt Füsun didn't use a glass or a spoon.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze ne bardak ne kaşık kullandı.

lines.en: She showed Elif everything.
"Feel the butter.
It must be soft.
Smell the lemon.
Look at the colour."
Elif watched her hands and did the same.
lines.tr: Elif onun ellerini izledi ve aynısını yaptı.

lines.en: The first cake was good.
The second cake was better.
At three o'clock, Elif had an idea.
lines.tr: Saat üçte Elif'in aklına bir fikir geldi.

lines.en: She went into the garden.
She came back with a few green leaves of mint.
lines.tr: Elinde birkaç yeşil nane yaprağıyla geri geldi.

lines.en: She put a little mint in the third cake.
Aunt Füsun tried it.
She closed her eyes for a long time.
"That's not my cake," she said at last.
"That's your cake."
On Sunday, the town square was full of people and cakes.
lines.tr: Pazar günü kasaba meydanı insan ve kekle doluydu.

lines.en: The judges tried every cake slowly.
lines.tr: Jüri her keki yavaş yavaş tattı.

lines.en: Mr Selim won with a big chocolate cake.
lines.tr: Selim Bey büyük bir çikolatalı kekle kazandı.

lines.en: Elif and Aunt Füsun came second.
lines.tr: Elif ile Füsun Teyze ikinci oldu.

lines.en: For a moment, Elif was sad.
Then she looked at Aunt Füsun.
Aunt Füsun was laughing, so Elif laughed, too.
lines.tr: Füsun Teyze gülüyordu, Elif de güldü.

lines.en: "Second is good," said Aunt Füsun.
"Next year, you're going to win.
And I'm going to write a new wrong card."
lines.tr: Ben de yeni bir yanlış kart yazacağım."

lines.en: Bora took a photo of them.
That evening, it got more likes than the cake.
lines.tr: O akşam fotoğraf, kekten daha çok beğeni aldı.

lines.en: That night, Elif opened her notebook for the last time.
lines.tr: O gece Elif defterini son kez açtı.

lines.en: Under "Find the recipe," she wrote one more line.
lines.tr: "Tarifi bul" yazısının altına bir satır daha yazdı.

lines.en: "Found.
It was in Aunt Füsun's hands.
Now it's in mine, too."

phrases.note: do the dishes: bulaşık yıkamak. Kek ve yemek için make, iş ve görev için do.
Türkçede "kek yapmak" ama İngilizcede do değil make.
Karşılaştırma: sıfat + -er + than ya da more + sıfat + than.
